visual_bible.style: cinematic practical macro photography with surreal object match cuts and restrained CGI
visual_bible.world: tactile walnut editing desk and abstract close-up transformations
visual_bible.lighting: warm tungsten key, cold cyan rim, precise real material reflections
visual_bible.palette: dark walnut, silver film, saturated amber and cobalt
character_anchors: adult Chinese male with stable facial proportions, off-white jacket
red Shiba Inu with cream chest and upright ears

title: Next Frame — five-second Shiba editor IP

required_story_events.description: The Shiba presses a real button
Calm human creator controls the film

shots.frame: 85mm macro composition of a fluffy Shiba paw and a scratched circular brass play button
shots.action: the paw presses the spring-loaded button until its rim glows
shots.camera: locked macro push-in with focus on the contact point
shots.lighting: tungsten highlight across the brass rim
shots.transition_out: match the illuminated brass circle to the circular exchange instrument
continuity: Shiba is red with cream chest; paw structure stays natural

shots.frame: close-up of a circular trading instrument whose red real-body candlesticks show wicks and depth ladder; transitions into a stamped silver dog token and film reel
shots.action: bar volumes and candlestick wicks move; rotating dial becomes dog-faced token, then a reel of photographic film
shots.camera: centered graphic match, rotation aligned along one axis
shots.lighting: specular silver reflections with cyan/amber accents
shots.transition_out: cut on a round black reel spindle matching the protagonist eye pupil
continuity: circle center stays within 10 percent of center frame

shots.frame: 50mm medium-close portrait with Shiba beside calm young creator at walnut editing desk
shots.action: creator lightly catches moving film strip between two fingers; motion aligns; dog ear twitches; subtle eye rise
shots.camera: fast but smooth reveal then stable two-subject portrait
shots.lighting: soft tungsten face key and cyan practical fill
shots.transition_out: hold final clean frame for later IP-title typography
continuity: single film strip and stable facial identity

ending: stable hero composition of human and Shiba, with title safe area at top
